verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client, so open/read tracking is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents read receipts, open tracking, or open timestamps. The activity log ("every action within Missive is logged") covers team actions inside Missive, not recipient opens, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email
